name: grimoire
description: A tool-agnostic catalog of reusable agent skills and composed workflows, starting with evidence-backed business planning.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed business planning, department by department
interface.longDescription: Grimoire turns a business direction into an evidence-aware plan. It establishes a baseline, selects the relevant departments, asks before assuming, researches material uncertainties, drafts Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Operations, and closes with a cross-department synthesis. Planning state is persisted so a long effort can be resumed later.
defaultPrompt: I want to plan a new business direction.
Resume the business plan I started earlier.
